### [`check_slippery`](../../../../src/engine/falling_checks.asm#L6) `$71FD`

*routine*

Returns Z set when cell code A is a boulder, a diamond or brick wall. Falling objects roll off these cells.

- **Called from:** [`handle_falling_diamond`](diamond.md#handle_falling_diamond) [`$72D3`](../../../../src/engine/diamond.asm#L42), [`handle_diamond`](diamond.md#handle_diamond) [`$7334`](../../../../src/engine/diamond.asm#L93), [`handle_boulder`](boulder.md#handle_boulder) [`$770D`](../../../../src/engine/boulder.asm#L17), [`handle_falling_boulder`](boulder.md#handle_falling_boulder) [`$777F`](../../../../src/engine/boulder.asm#L78)

<a id="check_hit_enemy"></a>
### [`check_hit_enemy`](../../../../src/engine/falling_checks.asm#L23) `$7214`

*routine*

Returns Z set when the cell at scan_ptr+Y is a butterfly ($30-$33) or firefly ($08-$0b). Sets explosion_code to $21 (diamonds) or $1c (space).

- **Called from:** [`handle_falling_diamond`](diamond.md#handle_falling_diamond) [`$7311`](../../../../src/engine/diamond.asm#L74), [`handle_falling_boulder`](boulder.md#handle_falling_boulder) [`$77C0`](../../../../src/engine/boulder.asm#L113)
- **Reads:** [`cell_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#cell_ptr)
- **Writes:** [`explosion_code`](../../memory-map.md#explosion_code)
